scope: Historical numeric identities pinned by the r5→r3→r2→r1 coverage chain. Separate recovery protocols are excluded from this historical aggregate.
eligibility: Include a variant only when all four historical condition identities exist and every eligible numeric record for each identity agrees in reward. Eligible recorded statuses are valid, valid_budget_exhaustion, scientific_failure, passed.
source_choice: Among equal-reward candidates prefer literal valid status, then lexicographically first result path. No reward-based ranking.
recovery_checks: The three subsequent file-reading checks all scored zero and are preserved separately in coverage.json; they do not overwrite historical observations.
interpretation: Descriptive matched comparison of recorded historical evaluations; all-artifacts subset tests whether observed advantage persists when all methods supply skills. Trace-based attribution is based on observed skill text, actions, and verifier checks; no component intervention was performed.
